title: stipa humilis var. genuina
intro: Stipa humilis var. genuina, commonly known as Dwarf Bunchgrass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is native to the western United States and is known for its compact growth habit and delicate foliage. The health benefits of Stipa humilis var. genuina include its potential use in the treatment of digestive issues and its ability to soothe inflammation, which is attributed to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
